requirement.description: Layout objects cannot be properly interpreted as integers, causing TypeError in various data layout operations. This affects Const construction, field access, and indexing operations when dealing with StructLayout and UnionLayout objects.
requirement.contract: Layout objects (StructLayout, UnionLayout, ArrayLayout) should properly support integer interpretation for size calculations and validation, and should correctly handle conversion to/from Python integers in constant construction and field access operations.

requirement.description: IO transformation operations fail due to improper handling of IOPort objects and their conversion to IO values. This leads to TypeErrors when attempting to concatenate, slice, or convert IO values.
requirement.contract: IOPort objects should properly support concatenation, slicing, and conversion to IO values without throwing TypeError exceptions. Operations on IO values should be consistent and predictable.

requirement.description: IR building and netlist generation fails when processing IO values, particularly when transforming IOPort and IOSlice objects to IR representations. This causes TypeErrors in netlist building operations.
requirement.contract: IO values (IOPort, IOSlice) should be properly convertible to IR representations during netlist building, and should not cause TypeError exceptions when processing fragments and ports.

requirement.description: IO value operations fail with TypeError due to incorrect handling of IOPort objects in various AST operations, particularly in IOValue operations and slice operations.
requirement.contract: IOValue operations should properly handle IOPort objects and not throw TypeError exceptions. Slice operations on IO values should work correctly.

requirement.description: Missing or incomplete implementation of View and Const classes, particularly around attribute access and field access operations. This causes AttributeErrors and TypeErrors when accessing fields or attributes of views and constants.
requirement.contract: View and Const classes should properly implement field and attribute access operations, including handling of reserved names and error messages for invalid accesses.
